title: Xerjoff Richwood For Man/Woman
body_html: Xerjoff's Richwood is a unisex Eau de Parfum from the XJ 17/17 collection, inspired by the minerals and semi-precious stones displayed at London's Natural History Museum. It is a woody chypre fragrance crafted by the talented nose, Chris Maurice. Its top notes of tangerine harmoniously blend with the fragrance's heart - a magnificent sandalwood from Mysore, one of the most exquisite materials in perfumery. A halo of crisp citrus crowns this mellow warmth, leading to a complex base of earthy patchouli, dark rose tinged with cassis, and balsamic vanilla. This elegant earthiness is reminiscent of a premier cru Bourgogne, making Richwood evocative of a vintage wine. The perfume is irresistibly sensual; its woody character underlined by an earthy base, creating a warm and captivating scent.

body_html: Introduced in 2018, Muse by Xerjoff is a Chypre Fruity fragrance, cherished by both women and men. This scent is a harmonious blend of sweet and fruity notes, with a profound aroma that evokes a sense of luxury. The first whiff entices with a surprisingly sweet and fruity sensation as the robust aroma of ripe plum merges seamlessly with the soft and delicate fragrance of white blossoms. The base notes feature a warm bed of Labdanum, Benzoin, and Amber accompanied by surprising hints of Raspberries. This radiant, above-average longevity fragrance is still in production as of now.
